name: crypto.kdf
doc:
crypto.kdf: key derivation. Pbkdf2 (RFC 8018) and Scrypt (RFC 7914)
are runtime functions (crypto/kdf.c); Argon2 (RFC 9106, version 0x13)
runs in C as well (std_argon2.c); Hkdf wraps crypto.hkdf.
Passwords and salts are []byte (strings.Bytes for strings); memory
is in KiB.

items.name: Argon2d
items.signature: func Argon2d(password []byte, salt []byte, time int, memory int, threads int, keyLen int) []byte!
items.doc: Argon2d: data-dependent memory access (fastest, for non-interactive use).
items.summary: Argon2d: data-dependent memory access (fastest, for non-interactive use).

items.name: Argon2i
items.signature: func Argon2i(password []byte, salt []byte, time int, memory int, threads int, keyLen int) []byte!

items.name: Argon2id
items.signature: func Argon2id(password []byte, salt []byte, time int, memory int, threads int, keyLen int) []byte!
items.doc:
Argon2id(password, salt, time, memory KiB, threads, keyLen): the
recommended password hash (RFC 9106 4: t=3, m=65536, p=4 or t=1,
m=2097152, p=4). The salt must have at least 8 bytes (16 recommended).
items.summary: Argon2id(password, salt, time, memory KiB, threads, keyLen): the recommended password hash (RFC 9106 4: t=3, m=65536, p=4 or t=1, m=2097152, p=4).

items.name: Hkdf
items.signature: func Hkdf(hash string, secret []byte, salt []byte, info []byte, keyLen int) []byte!
items.doc: HKDF (RFC 5869): Extract then Expand to keyLen bytes.
items.summary: HKDF (RFC 5869): Extract then Expand to keyLen bytes.

items.name: Pbkdf2
items.signature: func Pbkdf2(password []byte, salt []byte, iterations int, keyLen int, hash string) []byte!
items.doc: Pbkdf2 derives keyLen bytes with PBKDF2 (RFC 8018) over HMAC with hash ("sha1", "sha256", "sha384", "sha512").
items.summary: Pbkdf2 derives keyLen bytes with PBKDF2 (RFC 8018) over HMAC with hash ("sha1", "sha256", "sha384", "sha512").

items.name: Scrypt
items.signature: func Scrypt(password []byte, salt []byte, n int, r int, p int, keyLen int) []byte!
items.doc: Scrypt derives keyLen bytes with scrypt (RFC 7914); n is a power of two and the memory used is 128*r*n bytes.
items.summary: Scrypt derives keyLen bytes with scrypt (RFC 7914); n is a power of two and the memory used is 128*r*n bytes.

items.doc: Full Argon2 parameters (Argon2 with a secret key K and associated data X).
items.summary: Full Argon2 parameters (Argon2 with a secret key K and associated data X).
